According to Boyle’s law, $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$
$\Rightarrow V_2 = \frac{P_1 V_1}{P_2} = \frac{3 \times 400}{3.45} = 347 \mathrm{m}\lambda$
Hence, the correct option is (b).

9. $\mathrm{CH}_4 + 2\mathrm{O}_2 \rightarrow \mathrm{CO}_2 + 2\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}$
1 mole of $\mathrm{CH}_4 \rightarrow 2$ moles of $\mathrm{O}_2$.
$\mathrm{C}_2\mathrm{H}_6 + 7/2\mathrm{O}_2 \rightarrow 2\mathrm{CO}_2 + 3\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}$
1 mole of $\mathrm{C}_2\mathrm{H}_6 \rightarrow 3.5$ moles of $\mathrm{O}_2$.
$\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{H}_6 + 9/2\mathrm{O}_2 \rightarrow 3\mathrm{CO}_2 + 3\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}$
1 mole of $\mathrm{C}_3\mathrm{H}_6 \rightarrow 4.5$ moles of $\mathrm{O}_2$.
$\mathrm{C}_4\mathrm{H}_6 + 11/2\mathrm{O}_2 \rightarrow 4\mathrm{CO}_2 + 3\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}$
1 mole of $\mathrm{C}_4\mathrm{H}_6 \rightarrow 5.5$ moles of $\mathrm{O}_2$.
Hence, the correct option is (d).
